name: Uptime Kuma
summary: Self-hosted monitoring of websites and services, with status pages and notifications.
description:
Uptime Kuma checks your websites, APIs and services every few seconds and alerts you through more than 90 notification services. Public status pages show your users what is up.

The first visit asks for the database (choose SQLite) and creates the administrator account.
post_install: Open {{url}} now: the first visitor chooses the database and creates the administrator account.
